correctness.rationale: For a cyclic 11-free source, the only majority-one triple is 101, forcing output ones to mark input gap 2. Each output-one gap g is zero/nonzero according as it admits a composition of g-2 into nonempty parts at least 3, with g=2 represented by the empty composition. These independent local pieces glue uniquely around an indexed ring, proving the all-length product and singleton thresholds. The exceptional zero fiber is the trace of an explicit 3x3 integer matrix; cycle marking proves both all-length rational generating functions; aperiodic positive gap sets give sharp asymptotics. The extracted stdlib verifier enumerated every admissible input, every output fiber and independent gap counts through n=15 and passed. Finite checks alone are not the infinite proof.
